purpose: Reviewable scope, not a collector configuration or authorization grant
review_record_limit_means: Eligible records retained/ingested; native API candidate rows may include incompatible licenses that are discarded

sources.credit: Retain public author credit beside the text and original profile/source links; retain license and change notice; comply with ShareAlike on redistribution.
Retain original native review hyperlink, source credit, CC BY 4.0 license and any modification notice; skip incompatible licenses and remove issuer keys/JWTs.

retention.duration: Until manually deleted; no automatic purge or change to existing records
retention.fields: Permitted text, native rating/scale/date/ID, product association, original URL, collection timestamp, source/authorization/run references and required license/credit
retention.unnecessary_identity: Do not retain emails, private identities, avatars, JWTs or issuer keys
retention.exports: Private downloads only; preserve source/credit/license/change notices beside each record, including CSV/XLSX/JSON/JSONL/ZIP

stop_conditions: User has not explicitly approved this batch scope
Replit application code or account is inaccessible or integration is unverified
Permission revoked, scope mismatch or missing required attribution
Robots refusal, rate limit, unexpected redirect or TLS/database failure
